阿里巴巴-100053880001.title: 1688-跨境商详产品经理-杭州
阿里巴巴-100053880001.description:
1. 深耕跨境本地化体验：聚焦1688跨境核心市场，深入洞察买家需求与采购习惯，结合AI能力推动采购体验的本地化与智能化，提升买家采购效率。
2. 优化采购决策与交易转化：协同支付、物流及行业等团队，整合交易服务与营销能力，围绕买家关键决策诉求持续优化采购链路，降低决策成本，提升下单转化。
3. 数据驱动产品增长：独立负责商品详情页产品规划，建立以业务结果为核心的评估体系。通过A/B Test、数据分析及用户调研验证产品价值，推动复杂项目从0到1落地，对业务增长结果负责。
阿里巴巴-100053880001.requirements:
1. 专业背景：本科及以上学历，2–5年互联网产品工作经验；具备B2B电商、跨境电商或国际化产品经验者优先，有商详、或交易转化相关经验者优先。
2. 业务能力：具备扎实的产品规划与落地能力，能够拆解复杂的商品信息及跨境交易场景；拥有良好的跨团队协作能力，能高效协同研发、算法、设计、运营及支付物流团队。
3. 国际化视野：具备敏锐的跨文化洞察力，能够理解不同市场买家的采购习惯与决策差异；有海外学习、工作经历者优先。
4. 数据与技术敏感度：具备扎实的数据分析能力，能够通过漏斗分析与A/B Test驱动产品决策；对AI技术在本地化表达中的应用有浓厚兴趣，有相关实践经验者加分。

阿里巴巴-100053920002.title: 1688-跨境用户增长产品经理-杭州
阿里巴巴-100053920002.description:
1. 建设多渠道获客能力：聚焦1688跨境核心市场，负责跨境付费外投相关产品能力建设，协同算法与工程团队优化流量承接及商品匹配策略，并协同技术团队推进SEO能力建设，提升渠道获客与转化效率。
2. 搭建智能化用户触达体系：负责PUSH、EDM等触达产品的规划与建设，推动本地化渠道渠道产品能力落地和完善。结合AI能力完善多语、多模态内容生产与发送体系，提升触达效率与用户承接体验。
3. 建设用户画像与精准触达策略：围绕跨境买家的采购需求与行为特征，建设可复用的用户画像与标签体系。协同算法团队优化人货匹配，推动个性化触达策略落地。
4. 数据驱动产品增长：独立负责用户增长领域产品规划，建立以业务结果为核心的评估体系。通过A/B Test、漏斗分析及用户调研验证产品价值，推动复杂项目从0到1落地，对付费及触达渠道的UV规模与转化率负责。
阿里巴巴-100053920002.requirements:
1. 专业背景：本科及以上学历，2–4年互联网产品工作经验；具备用户增长、广告产品、营销触达或跨境电商相关经验者优先。
2. 业务能力：具备扎实的产品规划与落地能力，理解渠道获客、流量承接及用户触达的核心逻辑；能够拆解复杂业务场景，高效协同算法、研发、运营及市场团队推进项目落地。
3. 国际化视野：具备跨文化洞察力，能够理解不同市场用户的渠道偏好与行为差异；有国际化产品、海外留学经历相关经验者优先。
4. 数据与技术敏感度：具备扎实的数据分析与实验设计能力，能够通过数据驱动增长决策；对AI内容生成、用户画像及推荐策略在增长场景中的应用有浓厚兴趣，有相关实践经验者加分。

阿里巴巴-100015383019.title: ARGO事业部-解决方案架构师（金融科技）-ARGO（北京/深圳）
阿里巴巴-100015383019.description:
客户需求洞察及方案设计
• 掌握并理解客户的业务场景、整体技术架构、业务与IT战略优先级及业务成功指标，挖掘客户潜在需求，提供能满足客户需求的云和AI全栈方案，规划业务策略和实现路径，解答客户对产品、解决方案的常规问题。
• 基于对技术发展趋势的把握，作为策略规划和架构专家，与客户共同规划未来云和AI业务与技术规划，成为其可信赖的顾问，识别其中潜在的合作机会，并提出具备前瞻性的方案和架构设计。
售前引导与实操能力
• 针对客户对AI算力、大模型应用场景落地等需求，通过标杆案例及场景化演示，向客户高层展示阿里云AI全栈产品的竞争优势，确保技术方案与客户业务目标深度绑定。
• 通过技术影响力的建立，维护客户关系，构建PoC测试和方案选型，对POC结果负责，就安全性、稳定性、性能、可持续性和运行效率给出技术建议。

技术策略制定和项目赢单
• 分析复杂客户的情况，提出基于阿里云解决方案的建议，制定产品选型策略和技术路线图，将阿里云全栈AI产品技术与客户业务需求结合，帮助客户拓展AI应用新场景，推动技术采用。
• 针对重点项目/客户，面向客户高层介绍阿里云产品和解决方案的优势，传递技术价值及其带来的业务收益，引领客户向AI转型，推动项目顺利签约。
• 在售前规划和方案实施过程中，识别并有效应对技术和项目风险，协同产研及交付团队正常履约，实现收入转化，优化阿里云的效果与客户满意度。

能力沉淀和赋能

阿里巴巴-100017403001.description:
1. 负责 MaaS 模型托管部署产品的整体规划与全生命周期管理，定义模型接入、部署上线、运维迭代全流程的产品方案，持续降低客户使用门槛，提升托管模式的市场渗透率。
2. 深入理解企业级客户在性能确定性、资源与数据隔离、稳定性及合规等方面的核心诉求，定义产品形态、功能与交付标准。与基础设施、算法、工程团队紧密协作，将底层算力与推理能力抽象为客户易理解、可自助、可观测的产品。
3. 定义专属部署的 SLA 与可用性保障体系，与运营、SRE 团队协同落地，保障企业级服务的稳定与可信。设计专属部署的计费与商业化模式，输出有竞争力的定价策略与售卖组合，支撑 MaaS 业务商业化目标达成。
4. 制定部署产品的 GTM 策略，联动解决方案、销售与运营团队打造行业标杆案例，沉淀销售工具包与可复制打法，推动在重点行业客户中的规模化落地。
5. 对标国内外竞品的部署产品形态，持续跟踪 MaaS 赛道竞品动态与大模型客户需求变化，输出竞品分析与市场洞察，驱动产品功能与商业化策略的快速迭代。
阿里巴巴-100017403001.requirements:
1. 本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程等相关专业；5 年以上产品经理经验，具备云计算、IaaS/PaaS 或 AI 推理平台相关产品经验者优先。
2. 熟悉大模型产业链与客户使用场景，理解模型推理部署的基本业务逻辑，能从客户视角将技术能力转化为清晰的产品价值主张。
3. 具备完整的产品商业化与 GTM 实战经验，能围绕利用率、单位成本等指标做产品与定价决策，主导过云产品或 AI 产品从 0 到 1 并有可量化的商业结果。
4. 优秀的跨团队协作与项目推动能力，能高效拉通研发、算法、销售、解决方案等多方角色，在复杂环境中推动产品目标落地。
5. 具备较强的学习能力与前瞻视野，对行业主流 MaaS/云平台的部署产品形态有清晰认知，对行业趋势有敏锐的判断力。

阿里巴巴-100048140003.title: AliExpress-Influencer Channel BD (인플루언서 채널 BD)-Seoul/Hangzhou
阿里巴巴-100048140003.description:
1. 网红渠道增长操盘（为GMV负责）：深度深耕韩国本地网红生态与社媒流量规则，围绕平台销售目标，整体负责速卖通韩国市场网红渠道生意增长，对网红线GMV、成交转化、ROI等核心结果指标负责。
2. 达人合作模式开发与体系搭建：独立挖掘、拓展、维护本地头部/中腰部/垂类网红达人资源，持续创新短视频、种草、直播等多元化带货合作模式，沉淀可复制的标准化达人合作打法与渠道运营体系。
3. 网红营销项目全栈落地：统筹网红营销全流程，包含达人筛选、商务洽谈、方案策划、内容把控、上线投放及履约跟进，落地常态化种草及大促节点网红专项营销，高效撬动社媒流量增量。
4. 数据驱动策略迭代：持续监控网红渠道流量、转化、成交数据，定期复盘渠道及达人投产表现，基于数据优化达人结构、合作模式与投放策略，淘汰低效资源，持续提升渠道整体经营效率。
5. 跨团队协同提效：联动平台品类、运营、投放等团队，结合本地流行趋势输出适配的网红营销打法，借助达人矩阵实现品牌本地化曝光、用户拉新与生意增长，熟练运用AI工具赋能业务提效与决策。
1. Deeply cultivate the South Korean local influencer ecosystem and social media traffic algorithms. Aligning with the platform's sales targets, take overall ownership of business growth through influencer channels in the South Korean market, and be accountable for core performance metrics including influencer-driven GMV, conversion rates, and ROI.
2. Independently discover, expand, and maintain local top-tier, mid-tier, and vertical influencer resources. Continuously innovate diversified sales-driven cooperation models across short videos, product seeding, and live streaming, and establish replicable, standardized influencer cooperation playbooks and channel operation frameworks.
3. Manage the end-to-end influencer marketing process, including influencer sourcing, commercial negotiation, campaign planning, content quality control, campaign launch, and fulfillment tracking. Execute routine seeding campaigns as well as mega-sale influencer marketing projects to efficiently leverage incremental social media traffic.
4. Continuously monitor influencer channel traffic, conversion, and transaction data. Conduct regular reviews of channel and individual influencer ROI performance to optimize influencer portfolios, cooperation models, and media-buying strategies, filtering out low-efficiency resources to improve overall channel operational efficiency.
5. Partner with platform category, operations, and user acquisition teams to deliver tailored influencer marketing tactics based on local trending topics. Leverage the influencer matrix to drive local brand exposure, user acquisition, and business growth, and skillfully utilize AI tools to empower business efficiency and decision-making.
阿里巴巴-100048140003.requirements:
1. 3年及以上跨境电商网红营销、达人渠道运营、社媒流量商业化经验，熟悉韩国本土YouTube/Instagram网红生态、带货链路及平台流量规则，有速卖通、跨境平台韩区经验优先。
2. 具备成熟的达人商务能力与模式创新能力，擅长挖掘优质网红资源、自主设计差异化合作玩法，有成功的网红带货项目落地及GMV增长案例。
3. 强数据思维与结果导向，精通流量、转化、投产数据分析，能够通过数据洞察快速迭代运营策略，具备独立扛住业务指标、驱动生意增长的能力。
4. 中韩流利，英语加分，可独立完成本地达人商务对接、跨团队协同沟通，具备优秀的项目推进、问题攻坚能力与抗压能力。
5. 熟练使用各类AI及数据分析工具赋能业务，思维灵活、本地化市场敏感度高，适配杭州/首尔两地办公及本土化业务运营。
1. 3+ years of experience in cross-border e-commerce influencer marketing, creator channel operations, or social media traffic monetization. Deeply familiar with the South Korean local YouTube/Instagram influencer ecosystem, sales conversion funnels, and platform traffic algorithms. Experience with AliExpress or other cross-border e-commerce platforms focusing on the South Korean market is highly preferred.
2. Possess mature influencer business development (BD) and innovative model-building capabilities. Skilled at identifying high-quality influencer resources and independently designing differentiated collaboration tactics, with a proven track record of successful sales-driven influencer projects and GMV growth.
3. Strong data-driven mindset and result-orientation. Proficient in analyzing traffic, conversion, and ROI data, with the ability to quickly iterate operational strategies based on data insights. Capable of independently owning business targets and driving business growth.
4. Fluent in Chinese, Korean, proficiency in English is a plus. Able to independently handle commercial communications with local influencers and manage cross-functional collaboration. Excellent project management, problem-solving, and stress-tolerance skills.
5. Proficient in using various AI and data analysis tools to empower business workflows. Agile thinker with high sensitivity to local market trends. Adaptable to working in both Hangzhou and Seoul and managing localized business operations.

阿里巴巴-100055540004.title: AliExpress-法务专家-国家业务法务
阿里巴巴-100055540004.description:
We seek to hire a legal counsel of commercial legal who will be a key member of the growing legal team supporting AliExpress in global emerging markets. 

The attorney will be based in our Hangzhou office. 

Job Description 
1. Reporting to Legal Counsel, AliExpress, advise on legal aspects of the platform’s international growth of current and new e-commerce businesses, with a focus on global emerging markets. 
2. Provide advice on platform compliance, local and cross border logistics, customs and tariffs, personal data, product listing and other compliance matters. 
3. Research local laws and regulations in the local jurisdictions and manage external counsel. 
4. Provide advice to business teams on legal aspects of the implementation of commercial agreements, business models and strategies, business operations, supply chain operations and product offerings. 
5. Negotiate, draft, and review contracts, commercial agreements and policies. 
6. Address and respond to requests from overseas law enforcement agencies.
7. Develop in-house legal tools and policies, and conduct trainings to business units.
阿里巴巴-100055540004.source_type: 雇主官方公开职位API；JD正文已在本地归档

阿里巴巴-100025775024.title: AliExpress-法务专家-营销合规法务
阿里巴巴-100025775024.description:
We seek to hire a legal counsel of commercial legal who will be a key member of the growing legal team supporting AliExpress marketing business. The attorney will be based in our Hangzhou office. 

Job Description:
1. Reporting to Senior Legal Counsel, AliExpress, advise on legal aspects of the platform’s international growth of current and new e-commerce businesses, with a focus on marketing and AI compliance.
2. Provide advice on marketing compliance, consumer protection, AI compliance and other compliance matters.
3. Research local laws and regulations in the local jurisdictions and manage external counsels.
4. Provide advice to business teams on legal aspects of the implementation of commercial agreements, business models and strategies and business operations.
5. Negotiate, draft, and review contracts, commercial agreements, platform rules and policies.
6. Address and respond to requests from overseas law enforcement agencies.
7. Develop in-house legal tools (including AI tools) and policies, and conduct trainings to business units.

阿里巴巴-100010903002.title: Alibaba Cloud Intelligence-GenAI business development-Africa Region(Hangzhou/Beijing Base)
阿里巴巴-100010903002.description:
Customer Development and Opportunity Identification
•Responsible for developing international AI-native enterprises, startups, AI data service providers, and developer customer. Identify and quickly assess market opportunities in emerging growth sectors to generate effective business opportunities.
•Gain an in-depth understanding of the customer's industry, comprehend their business model and operational processes, deconstruct their production chain and corresponding pain points, and identify effective AI application scenarios to find potential cooperation opportunities.
•Promote standardized AI products, platforms, and Agent-based applications. By exploring customer usage scenarios in depth, drive a leap in token usage to provide value to customers.
•Engage in dialogue with key customer business leaders, maintain good relationships at critical decision-making points, coordinate connections between Alibaba Cloud’s senior management and customers, and build long-term business and technical relationships at all levels of the client organization to gain trust and secure crucial support during collaboration.
AI Value Communication
•Help customers understand the technical value and applicable scenarios of Alibaba Cloud’s MaaS products, as well as the differentiated advantages of Alibaba Cloud products compared to advanced models in the global market.

阿里巴巴-100016443001.title: Alibaba Cloud Intelligence-Market Intelligence Expert-Hong Kong SAR
阿里巴巴-100016443001.description:
1. Identify high-potential AI native and enterprise AI-related customers. Continuously track, build, and maintain a high-potential customer pool, and conduct preliminary assessments of each customer’s development stage, business model, AI use cases and business scenarios, cloud and AI related requirements, and potential entry points.
2. Convert market insights into leads gen capabilities. Translate industry trends, customer signals, and competitive dynamics into sales-actionable lead lists, customer segmentation, priority rankings, and outreach recommendations.
3. Assess customer needs and sales conversion potential. Validate customer potential through multiple information sources, determine whether customers have clear needs for cloud services, computing resources, model services, and related solutions, and provide sales teams with conversion path recommendations, including suggested business entry points, key contact profiles, and initial communication angles.
4. Collaborate cross-functionally and build a closed-loop business process. Work with sales teams to establish a closed-loop mechanism covering customer identification, evaluation, sales follow-up, conversion tracking, and continuous iteration. Regularly collect sales feedback on lead quality, customer responses, conversion results, and reasons for non-conversion, and use the feedback to optimize customer screening criteria and analytical models.
阿里巴巴-100016443001.requirements:
1. 5+ years of experience in market intelligence, industry research, AI products analysis, investment research, or related fields. The candidate should have interest in and understanding of the AI related industry, with familiarity in at least one area such as AI application companies, AI infrastructure, model services, or venture capital-related ecosystems.
2. Ability to identify potential customers and business opportunities from complex market information, convert insights into actionable customer lists and sales recommendations, and establish customer screening and evaluation frameworks to assess customer potential, demand intensity, conversion timing, competitive dynamics, and recommended priority.
3. Familiarity with methodologies and tools for industry research, market intelligence, competitive analysis, customer analysis, business model analysis, and GTM analysis. Outputs should be business-oriented and directly usable by sales teams, such as customer profiles, opportunity assessments, entry-point recommendations, and competitive insights, rather than only trend reports.
4. Strong passion for the AI industry and strong learning agility, with the ability to continuously track AI technologies, products, startups, capital flows, and evolving customer needs.
5. Strong cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to provide clear judgments and actionable recommendations to sales, product, and management teams. The candidate should be hands-on, results-oriented, and willing to work closely with frontline business teams to validate lead quality and conversion outcomes. Fluent English is required.

阿里巴巴-100055480004.title: Alibaba Cloud Intelligence-Partner Development Sales-ISV-Shanghai，Hangzhou
阿里巴巴-100055480004.description:
Role Overview
Alibaba Cloud International is seeking an experienced Global ISV Partner Development Manager to expand our global software and AI ecosystem. This role will own a portfolio of strategic ISV accounts while identifying and recruiting high-potential new partners, managing partnerships from commercial negotiation and cloud/AI adoption through solution integration, co-selling, and international expansion.
The successful candidate will drive two complementary business motions: “Partner as Customer,” accelerating ISVs’ adoption and consumption of Alibaba Cloud infrastructure and AI services; and “Partner to Customer,” leveraging their products, solutions, and customer reach to create scalable joint go-to-market opportunities.
The role focuses on high-growth AI ISVs, SaaS companies, enterprise software providers, and emerging technology partners. We are looking for a commercially driven, hands-on business developer who can engage founders and C-level executives, understand cloud and AI economics, structure complex partnerships, and mobilize global and regional teams to deliver measurable revenue, consumption, and customer growth.
Key Responsibilities
1. Global ISV Strategy and Partner as Customer
● Recruit and grow strategic Global ISVs, prioritizing AI-native companies, SaaS providers, and enterprise software vendors based on product fit, international reach, and cloud/AI revenue potential.
● Own strategic ISV accounts and build trusted relationships with founders and C-level executives, driving adoption, renewals, consumption growth, and account expansion.
● Develop joint business plans that position Alibaba Cloud infrastructure, AI services, and Qwen capabilities to address partners’ product innovation and international deployment needs, with clear revenue, consumption, and pipeline targets.
2. AI and Technology Partnership Development
● Develop partnerships across the AI ecosystem, including foundation models, multimodal AI, agents, inference optimization, developer tools, and AI applications.
● Coordinate product, engineering, and solution architecture teams to validate use cases, enable integrations, and launch differentiated joint solutions.
● Structure commercially viable partnerships covering cloud commitments, incentives, licensing, and revenue share. Translate AI usage and deployment economics into business cases and forecasts, coordinating legal and compliance reviews for IP, model licensing, data residency, and cross-border requirements.
3. Joint GTM, Co-Selling, and Marketplace Growth
● Execute joint GTM and co-selling plans with regional sales, marketing, and channel teams, connecting partner solutions to priority industries, named accounts, and customer needs.
● Build repeatable sales plays, partner enablement, and demand-generation programs that convert customer introductions, workshops, and campaigns into qualified pipeline and revenue.
● Drive marketplace onboarding, offer development, and sales growth, while helping ISVs expand internationally through local field teams, channels, and ecosystem resources.
4. Commercial Ownership and Partner Performance
● Manage end-to-end commercial opportunities from qualification and negotiation through contracting, deployment, renewal, and expansion, with accountability for revenue, consumption, and commitment attainment.
● Maintain accurate account plans, pipelines, forecasts, and consumption tracking. Lead MBRs/QBRs to assess results, address gaps, and agree corrective actions.
● Resolve partner and customer escalations, coordinate internal stakeholders, and manage commercial, compliance, and credit risks. Prioritize resources by strategic value and capture successful partnership models in scalable playbooks.
阿里巴巴-100055480004.requirements:
Qualifications
● 8+ years of relevant experience in cloud, AI, enterprise software, SaaS, platform partnerships, strategic alliances, business development, or technology sales. Equivalent experience will be considered.
● Proven record of building and growing strategic ISV, SaaS, AI, or technology-platform partnerships that produced measurable cloud consumption, revenue, pipeline, solution adoption, or customer outcomes.
● Strong understanding of cloud and AI business models, including infrastructure consumption, SaaS economics, marketplace transactions, model APIs, inference and training workloads, licensing, revenue share, and commitment-based commercial structures.
● Demonstrated ability to engage founders, C-level executives, product leaders, and technical decision-makers, influence partner strategy, and maintain executive relationships through complex negotiations and escalations.
● Strong B2B sales fundamentals, including discovery, account planning, stakeholder mapping, opportunity qualification, value proposition development, ROI modeling, forecasting, negotiation, and contract closure.
● Ability to independently manage the end-to-end partnership and sales cycle—from partner sourcing and qualification through technical validation, commercial structuring, contracting, GTM execution, and revenue realization.
● Experience developing joint business plans, co-sell programs, marketplace offers, partner enablement, and scalable GTM playbooks across multiple countries or regions.
● Strong analytical discipline and comfort working with partner operating metrics such as revenue, cloud consumption, token or workload volumes, pipeline, conversion, customer acquisition, and forecast accuracy.
● Excellent interpersonal, presentation, public-speaking, negotiation, and written-communication skills in English. Additional language capabilities relevant to Alibaba Cloud’s international markets are an advantage.
● Ability to operate effectively in a highly cross-functional, multicultural, and fast-moving environment, coordinating regional sales, product, engineering, solution architecture, marketing, finance, legal, compliance, procurement, and operations teams.
● High ownership, sound judgment, commercial creativity, and the resilience to handle ambiguity, difficult stakeholders, long sales cycles, and high-stakes partnership decisions.

Preferred Qualifications
● Existing relationships within the global AI, SaaS, enterprise software, venture capital, accelerator, cloud marketplace, or developer ecosystem.
● Experience working for or partnering with Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or a leading AI or SaaS platform.
● Experience recruiting ISVs from competitor ecosystems and creating a differentiated reason for them to adopt, build on, list with, and co-sell through a new cloud platform.
● Familiarity with Qwen or other foundation-model ecosystems, generative AI applications, model deployment, inference optimization, and AI-related intellectual-property or licensing considerations.
● Experience supporting ISVs entering new international markets and navigating data residency, cross-border data, security, procurement, tax, and contractual requirements.
● Track record of converting strategic partnerships into repeatable sales plays and sustainable business growth rather than relying on relationship management alone.

Success Measures
Success will be evaluated through strategic-account retention and renewal rates; committed-consumption attainment; cloud and AI consumption growth; the quality and strategic relevance of recruited ISVs; direct, marketplace, and partner-influenced revenue; qualified co-sell pipeline and win rate; joint solution launches; expansion into priority markets; executive partner engagement; forecast accuracy; customer success; and the creation of repeatable partnership models that can scale across Alibaba Cloud International.

阿里巴巴-100017163005.title: Alibaba Cloud Intelligence-业务拓展經理-出海业务/金融 /上海
阿里巴巴-100017163005.description:
Customer Relationship Building and Business Opportunity Development
•Proactively analyze key industries within the assigned country/market, identify key or potential customers, and independently map out the customer’s decision-making chain to uncover real needs.
•Engage customers using their business language to build trust, uncover product and technical requirements, and convert those requirements into qualified sales opportunities.
•Drive upsell and cross-sell initiatives with existing customers, enhance their experience across service and business collaboration, accelerate cloud resource consumption.
•Maintain regular contact with both existing and prospective customers to stay informed of their business strategies, budget cycles, vendor landscape, organizational structure, and technical environment.
Product and Technical Value Communication
•Leverage in-depth understanding of the customer’s industry and business context to help them recognize the technical value of Alibaba Cloud’s core offerings — including the Apsara Cloud Operating System, the “7 Core Products” and AI/Intelligent Computing solutions — while clearly articulating Alibaba Cloud’s differentiated competitive advantages over rival providers, reinforcing its positioning as the customer’s optimal strategic partner.
•Independently deliver presentations to customers on Alibaba Cloud’s standardized product solutions; or, with support from Solutions Architects (SA), independently articulate tailored solutions aligned with the customer’s specific business scenarios — clearly communicating the competitive advantages of Alibaba Cloud’s offerings and the concrete business value they enable for the customer.
Drive Decision-Making and Opportunity Conversion
• Drive rapid customer decision-making and sustained adoption of Alibaba Cloud products and technical solutions through effective resource integration and strategic engagement — ensuring continuous value delivery to the customer.
• Employ a full range of sales strategies — including persuasive communication, commercial negotiation, and tailored pricing proposals — to convert opportunities into closed deals, achieving performance targets while fostering mutually beneficial outcomes with customers.
• Proactively identify and escalate customer experience issues encountered during product usage, driving internal cross-functional collaboration to resolve them — thereby catalyzing improvements in Alibaba Cloud’s product solutions, service delivery, and operational processes.
Business Support
•Provide end-to-end business support throughout the customer lifecycle by coordinating cross-functional resources to ensure successful project implementation, and proactively identifying and resolving product usage issues in a timely manner.
•Accelerate the iterative adoption and optimization of Alibaba Cloud products on the customer side to effectively support the achievement of their technical objectives.
阿里巴巴-100017163005.requirements:
• Over 5 year of experience in cloud computing industry, with proven track record in public cloud sales and B2B/B2G sales or pre-sales roles
• Prior experience in large-scale customer stack migration 
• Prior experience in scaling revenue across Key Accounts (KA)
• Industry-specific domain expertise preferred
• Experience working with core competitors preferred
• Understand how various products deliver value in common industry/business scenarios; demonstrate the ability to comprehend customers’ business operations & digital transformation needs, and identify their pain points.
• Diagnose technical challenges within customers' specific business contexts and propose competitive solutions. 
• Establish partnerships with mid-to-large enterprises from scratch; accurately identify key internal influencers and rapidly build trust.
• Demonstrate tangible value quickly during initial customer entry; anticipate potential future product adoption scenarios and pre-embed expansion steps and strategies for scalable growth.
• Develop a detailed, quantified upsell roadmap and translate it into a comprehensive, customer-endorsed CSPA ,clearly define strategy, execution path, and numerical targets.
• Lead customer upgrade initiatives — for example, expanding consumption from IaaS infrastructure resources to higher-value services such as PaaS, data, and AI solutions.
• Independently initiate "Call High" engagements with customer stakeholders (e.g., CTO or project owner), conduct effective business and technical dialogues, influence and accelerate decision-making.
• Understand customer requirements and be familiar with Alibaba Cloud partner policies and the partner directory.
• Manage customer expectations, assess partner strengths and weaknesses, and conduct effective partner selection.
• Build multi-level relationship networks within customer organizations; effectively influence key decision-makers and secure critical project intelligence.
• Lead end-to-end execution of mid-sized projects — including formulating competitive strategies, coordinating cross-functional resources, conducting negotiations, and closing contracts — to achieve target outcomes.

阿里巴巴-100015743007.title: Alibaba Cloud-Data Center Regional Program Manager-Seoul, Korea
阿里巴巴-100015743007.description:
Alibaba Infrastructure Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Globe. We are dedicated to delivering ""last mile customer value"" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Job Responsibilities:
1. Drive the end-to-end rollout of the colocation management standard across the facilities under your remit, covering eight dimensions — Equipment, Personnel, Monitoring, Emergency Response, Drills, Change, Maintenance, and Flying-Inspection Risk — each executed against its tiered requirements. Apply rigorous project management to translate every requirement into project plans, milestones, and acceptance criteria, and track each gap to closure as a managed deliverable.
2. Lead the EMS (Environment Monitoring System) data-integration project in accordance with the applicable integration standard. Leveraging solid expertise in infrastructure facilities and low-voltage / ELV systems (monitoring, BMS, automation controls), manage the full lifecycle of data-point mapping, connection, validation, and ongoing maintenance to ensure full-scope, accurate telemetry into the monitoring platform — including IT room temperature/humidity, busway and rack power consumption, and the status, alarm, setpoint, and log values of all route-related equipment (dedicated and shared) affecting the rooms. For new architectures or devices not covered by the standard, drive integration following the same principle.
3. Partner closely with the local operations teams and the engineering delivery teams, providing professional project management and technical support. Drawing on strong vendor-negotiation and program-management skills, align and negotiate scope, standard compliance, SLAs, and remediation items with colocation providers and platform vendors; coordinate internal engineering, colo teams, and vendors through project plans, RACI, risk/issue logs, and delivery cadence to drive milestones to closure across multiple stakeholders and geographies.
4. Lead the review and validation of the electrical, HVAC, and low-voltage / ELV automation control logic (including BMS networks, monitoring, and automation controls), parameters, setpoints, and closed-loop stability delivered by colocation providers and vendors. Backed by deep infrastructure facility and ELV engineering knowledge, orchestrate technical experts to validate architecture drawings, key-equipment run logic (medium-voltage logic, protection setpoints, cooling control), and redundancy / single-point-of-failure analysis, and sign off through rigorous acceptance testing to ensure production readiness.
5. Build dashboards and scorecards for standard compliance and EMS integration health, report progress and risks to global headquarters, and drive data-based continuous improvement.
6. Collaborate with global headquarters on standards evolution and platform roadmap, adapt global policies to the local context, and build regional capability through training, certification, and knowledge transfer.
阿里巴巴-100015743007.requirements:
1. Bachelor's degree or higher in a technical discipline. Over 8 years of experience in infrastructure operations, with proven track record in colocation provider management or vendor governance.
2. Solid understanding of critical infrastructure systems (electrical, HVAC) with demonstrated ability to orchestrate technical resources and drive engineering initiatives from concept to delivery — someone who knows how to get things done right.
3. Proven track record in vendor governance, operational auditing, and performance improvement. Ability to establish high operational standards and drive colocation providers to exceed baseline expectations.
4. Strong project management capabilities with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple stakeholders and geographies. Resourceful in navigating ambiguity and pushing through organizational barriers.
5. Experience in infrastructure risk governance, including risk identification, root cause analysis, and mitigation execution. Demonstrated ability to drive systematic improvements and close action items with discipline.
6. Self-starter with high ownership and bias for action. Proven ability to identify opportunities, challenge existing approaches, and drive innovative solutions independently. Someone who gets energized by hard problems and is willing to go the extra mile for meaningful work.
7. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to build trust and influence across diverse cultural and organizational contexts. Mandarin proficiency is a plus.
8. Willingness to travel internationally (up to 30-40% of time).

阿里巴巴-100045460003.title: Alibaba Cloud-Global Ethics & Compliance Investigations Expert-Frankfurt / Munich
阿里巴巴-100045460003.description:
About the Role
We are seeking an analytical and principled Global Ethics & Compliance Investigations Expert to oversee business ethics, anti-fraud initiatives, and compliance investigations across our European operations.
In this role, you will independently or collaboratively conduct fact-finding inquiries into alleged misconduct, ensure all actions align with EU and local legal frameworks — including labor laws, employee data privacy, and whistleblower protection directives — drive case resolutions and risk remediations, and firmly safeguard the company's integrity baseline.

Key Responsibilities
● Case Investigations & Fact-FindingHandle internal whistleblowing allegations and investigative leads across Europe. Lead or participate in end-to-end investigations into commercial bribery, misappropriation of assets, conflicts of interest, and significant Code of Conduct violations — including gathering evidence, conducting witness and subject interviews, and drafting formal investigation reports.
● Procedural Compliance & Lawful ExecutionStrictly follow local legal procedures to ensure that all evidence gathering is lawful, due process is respected, and the investigative chain of custody is defensible.

阿里巴巴-100053660006.title: Alibaba Group-Admin & Workspace Manager-Japan
阿里巴巴-100053660006.description:
Facilities Operations: 
• Manage, mentor, and develop a team of administrative staffs in Japan, Korea and Taiwan, ensuring clear delegation of daily operational tasks, equitable workload distribution, and continuous professional growth.
• Conduct regular performance reviews and foster a high-performance, collaborative team culture.
• Direct all daily operations for the workspace, guaranteeing a secure, compliant, and highly efficient environment with zero unplanned facility downtime.
• Oversee comprehensive facilities management, including preventative maintenance programs, emergency response protocols, and root-cause analysis for operational issues.
• Manage outsourced service providers and internal facilities staff, ensuring equitable treatment, continuous coaching, and strict adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs).
• Ensure full regulatory compliance, overseeing property insurance policies, building codes, health and safety standards, and the timely filing of corporate and tax documentation with relevant authorities.
• Maintain rigorous asset tracking systems and implement standardized operational ticketing and data retention processes

Forecast Planning:
• Formulate and execute long-term office space planning strategies aligned with headcount forecasting, business growth trajectories, and lease lifecycle management.
• Lead end-to-end renovation and expansion projects: define scope through advanced data collection (surveys, spatial audits, utilization metrics), establish budgets, and manage schedules.
• Direct cross-functional teams of architects, design professionals, and construction contractors to ensure capital projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to exact quality specifications.
• Conduct market research on industry-leading space planning methodologies to optimize layouts for collaboration, efficiency, and cost-effectiveness.

Budget Management:
• Assume full P&L responsibility for the Japan, Korea and Taiwan office’s administrative budget, driving maximum ROI on all expenditures.
• Develop, track, and report on both OPEX (utilities, maintenance, supplies) and CAPEX (capital improvements) budgets in close partnership with the Finance department.
• Execute strategic cost analyses to identify efficiencies, utilizing historical spending patterns and growth factors to develop accurate financial forecasts.
• Manage cross-Business Unit (BU) chargeback principles, accrual records, and prompt invoice processing to ensure financial accuracy.

Procurement & Vendor Governance:
• Enforce robust procurement procedures for office inventory, property, and equipment, ensuring alignment with corporate governance and budgetary constraints.
• Lead competitive bidding processes, conducting rigorous cost/benefit analyses to evaluate vendor proposals objectively. Partner with Legal and Finance to review contracts, continuously optimizing vendor portfolios.

Organizational Culture & Stakeholder Engagement
• Work closely with Organizational Culture Lead to develop and implement comprehensive cultural communication plans and activities in alignment with Headquarters and H.R. 
• Oversee the logistics and execution of internal and external events designed to elevate employer branding, foster engagement, and attract top-tier talent, coordinating event execution through your team.
• Establish and enforce organizational standards, measuring outcomes against KPIs to drive continuous improvement in employee satisfaction and internal efficiency.

Data Analytics & Cross-Functional Integration:
• Leverage administrative business data extraction, integration, and analysis to inform executive decision-making and optimize workplace strategies.
• Serve as the primary liaison between the Japan, Korea, and Taiwan office and central support functions (Finance, HR, IT, Procurement), independently managing horizontal coordination and vertical execution while guiding your staff in day-to-day cross-departmental interactions.

• Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline is strongly preferred

• Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, influence decisions, and build consensus with senior leadership, while efficiently delegating tactical execution to a small team
• Proven capacity to operate independently, balancing high-level strategic planning with meticulous attention to operational detail and team oversight.

阿里巴巴-100053680005.title: Alibaba Group-Commercial Real Estate Asset Management & Leasing Manager-Hong Kong
阿里巴巴-100053680005.description:
We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Commercial Real Estate Asset Management & Leasing Manager to lead our Hong Kong portfolio. This is a seasoned role requiring a professional who combines asset management rigor with forward-thinking leasing and tenant-relationship strategy. The successful candidate will take full ownership of asset performance, leasing and occupancy growth, budget optimization, and landlord-tenant engagement for the Hong Kong commercial properties under management. 

We require a seasoned leader capable of operating autonomously, managing complex stakeholder relationships, and delivering a high-performing, fully leased commercial portfolio that maximizes asset value and drives sustainable rental income growth. 

Asset Management Leadership & Portfolio Performance: 
•	Direct all daily operations for the Hong Kong commercial portfolio, guaranteeing safe, compliant, and well-maintained properties with zero unplanned disruption to tenants. 
•	Oversee comprehensive property and facilities management, including preventative maintenance programs, emergency response protocols, and root-cause analysis for building operational issues. 
•	Manage property managers, outsourced service providers, and internal staff, ensuring equitable treatment, continuous coaching, and strict adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs). 
•	Ensure full regulatory compliance, overseeing property insurance policies, building codes, fire and safety standards, tenancy-related statutory filings, and the timely submission of corporate and tax documentation with relevant authorities. 
•	Maintain rigorous asset registers and lease administration records, and implement standardized operational ticketing and data retention processes 

Leasing Strategy, Tenant Acquisition & Asset Enhancement 
•	Formulate and execute leasing and occupancy strategies for the portfolio, aligned with market conditions, tenancy expiry profiles, rental growth targets, and lease lifecycle management. 
•	Lead end-to-end leasing transactions: define requirements through advanced data collection (market surveys, tenant needs audits, utilization metrics), establish deal terms, and manage negotiations through to handover. 
•	Direct cross-functional teams of leasing agents, fit-out contractors, design professionals, and legal advisors to ensure tenant fit-out projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to exact quality specifications. 
•	Conduct market research on industry-leading leasing practices, rental benchmarks, and tenant amenity trends to optimize space offerings for tenant attraction, retention, and revenue effectiveness. 

Financial & Budget Management; 
•	Assume full P&L responsibility for the Hong Kong portfolio, driving maximum NOI (net operating income) and ROI on all assets and expenditures. 
•	Develop, track, and report on both OPEX (utilities, maintenance, property management fees) and CAPEX (asset enhancement works) budgets in close partnership with the Finance department. 
•	Execute strategic rental and cost analyses to identify efficiencies, utilizing historical income and spending patterns and market growth factors to develop accurate financial forecasts. 
•	Manage tenant billing, recovery of outgoings, arrears collection, accrual records, and prompt invoice processing to ensure financial accuracy. 

Tenant Relations & Stakeholder Governance 
•	Enforce robust tenancy management procedures, lease documentation standards, and tenant onboarding/offboarding processes, ensuring alignment with corporate governance and asset objectives. 
•	Lead competitive agency engagements and tender processes, conducting rigorous cost/benefit analyses to evaluate proposals objectively. Partner with Legal and Finance to review lease contracts, continuously optimizing the tenant mix and agency portfolios.
阿里巴巴-100053680005.requirements:
Tenant Engagement & Property Marketing 
•	Develop and implement comprehensive marketing and tenant communication plans for the portfolio in alignment with Headquarters' asset strategy. 
•	Oversee the logistics and execution of tenant events, property viewings, and marketing campaigns designed to elevate property branding, foster tenant engagement, and attract top-tier occupiers, coordinating execution through your team. 
•	Establish and enforce property management standards, measuring outcomes against KPIs to drive continuous improvement in tenant satisfaction and operational efficiency. 

Data Analytics & Cross-Functional Integration 
•	Leverage portfolio data extraction, integration, and analysis (occupancy, rental, arrears, tenant metrics) to inform executive decision-making and optimize asset and leasing strategies. 
•	Serve as the primary liaison between the Hong Kong portfolio and central support functions (Finance, Legal, IT, Procurement, HQ system team), independently managing horizontal coordination and vertical execution while guiding your staff in day-to-day cross-departmental interactions. 

Education & Professional Experience 
•	Bachelor’s degree required; a degree in Real Estate, Land Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline is strongly preferred 
•	Minimum 6 years of progressive experience in commercial real estate asset management, leasing, or property management within an institutional landlord, REIT, developer, or large multinational corporation (MNC) 
•	Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, negotiate with tenants and agents, influence decisions, and build consensus with senior leadership, while efficiently delegating tactical execution to a small team 
•	Proven capacity to operate independently, balancing high-level asset strategy with meticulous attention to leasing transactions, operational detail, and team oversight. 
•	A demonstrated desire for sustained career growth within a global organization, approaching this mandate as a long-term leadership opportunity rather than a transitional role. 
•	Full professional proficiency in Mandarin Chinese (written and spoken) is strictly preferred to facilitate seamless strategic communication with Headquarters in China. English communication skills are equally essential.

阿里巴巴-100053500009.title: Alibaba Group-Senior Admin & Asset Management Specialist-Hong Kong
阿里巴巴-100053500009.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic, meticulous, and service-oriented Senior Admin & Asset 
Management Specialist to support the daily operations of our Hong Kong office. Reporting to the Senior Project Management Specialist for Administration & Asset Management, the successful candidate will be responsible for executive reception, administrative coordination, facilities management, budget optimization, and procurement execution. 

This is a hands-on senior specialist role ideally suited for a professional who combines extensive high-end protocol experience with solid operational capability — equally adept at coordinating government and executive business receptions as at efficiently managing internal administrative services, budgets, and financial matters. The ideal candidate will thrive in a fastpaced, multinational environment and serve as a trusted interface between internal stakeholders, external partners, and government and VIP visitors. 

Executive Reception & Administrative Operations 
•	Coordinate and manage reception arrangements for senior government officials, corporate executives, and VIP visitors, ensuring a seamless and professional experience from arrival to departure. 
•	Support end-to-end service logistics for executive meetings, business negotiations, and site inspections, including venue preparation, seating protocols, and in-meeting coordination and support. 
•	Participate in developing and maintaining standardized reception procedures (SOPs) aligned with corporate brand standards. 
•	Coordinate all daily administrative operations for the Hong Kong office, working closely with building management, IFM service providers, and security teams to ensure smooth and efficient administrative operations and service delivery at all times, creating a productive, orderly, and safe working environment. 
•	Oversee and manage IFM service providers, monitoring adherence to service-level agreements (SLAs) through regular performance evaluations. 
•	Maintain rigorous asset tracking systems for office equipment, furniture, and IT peripherals, conducting periodic physical audits and reconciling with the fixed-asset register. 

Financial & Budget Management 
•	Assist in developing the annual administrative operating budget and expenditure plan, utilizing historical spending analysis and headcount forecasting to produce accurate projections. 
•	Process invoices, expense reimbursements, and payment requisitions in accordance with corporate financial policies and procedures, ensuring complete and compliant approval workflows. 
•	Manage accrual records, prepayments, and cross-BU chargeback allocations in close coordination with the Finance department. 
•	Conduct cost-benefit analyses on recurring expenditures to identify efficiency opportunities and drive continuous cost optimization. 

Procurement & Vendor Management 
•	Execute end-to-end procurement processes for office supplies, equipment, and professional services, ensuring compliance with corporate governance and approval requirements. 
•	Collect and evaluate vendor proposals, conduct cost-benefit comparisons, and present recommendations to the Procurement department. 
•	Collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Procurement to draft and review vendor contracts, negotiating favorable terms on pricing, payment schedules, warranties, and service-level commitments. 
•	Maintain a qualified vendor database, conducting periodic supplier performance evaluations and market scanning to ensure competitive pricing and service quality. 
•	Track purchase orders from issuance through goods receipt, resolving discrepancies and ensuring timely three-way matching (purchase order, goods receipt note, invoice).
阿里巴巴-100053500009.requirements:
Cross-Functional Coordination 
•	Serve as the primary liaison between the Hong Kong office and central support functions (Finance, HR, IT, Procurement, Legal), managing horizontal coordination and vertical execution. 
•	Prepare periodic administrative reports, KPI dashboards, and ad-hoc analyses for leadership reviews. 
•	Support special projects as assigned, including office relocation, renovation, expansion, and new-site commissioning activities. 

Education & Professional Experience 
•	Bachelor’s degree required o above; a degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline is preferred. 
•	Minimum 5 years of experience in government administration, corporate administration, or general services, with demonstrated hands-on experience hosting senior government officials, diplomatic delegations, and corporate executives; thorough understanding of protocol standards and confidentiality requirements. 
•	Strong working knowledge of financial processes, including budgeting, invoice processing, and procurement workflows; experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) is an advantage. 
•	Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and familiarity with collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams and DingTalk. 
•	Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities, with meticulous attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving. 
•	Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively and build consensus with senior leadership, external partners, and cross-functional teams. 
•	Full professional proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken); Cantonese proficiency is a distinct advantage for local stakeholder engagement.

阿里巴巴-7000041203.title: Alibaba Holding-Director, Federal Government Affairs-Washington D.C
阿里巴巴-7000041203.description:
The Director, Federal Government Affairs for the U.S. will report to the Head of Government Relations for North America. This role will manage proactive engagement with and monitoring of relevant government officials and actions related to Alibaba and its ecosystem at the Federal level, particularly with respect to Agencies. S/He will strategically manage Alibaba’s legislative and regulatory advocacy initiatives related to ecommerce, digital services, product safety, intellectual property, technology development and deployment, consumer protection, logistics, customs, export controls, tax, and competition issues. The Director, Federal Government Relations will be charged with understanding and working effectively within the political dynamics presented by advocating for a global business headquartered in China. This role will also include day-to-day engagement with external resources, such as consultancies and trade associations, as well as any relevant third-party relationships. It is important that s/he be able to anticipate risks and opportunities, advise on engagement strategies and advocate on behalf of Alibaba.

In addition, the Director, Federal Government Affairs for the U.S. will:

• Work within the IGA team to develop and execute a government affairs program for Alibaba in the region which advances its business growth, legislative and regulatory goals, and political objectives. 
• Develop and foster relationships with key officials, engage via industry and government forums and manage relevant consultants and trade associations. 
• Establish solid working relationships with colleagues at headquarters and work closely with colleagues internationally to develop and implement industry and government outreach.  
• Provide senior executives and colleagues with strategic advice and insightful perspectives concerning government actions and politics regarding the industry and Alibaba in particular. 
• Coordinate across internal teams to ensure proper compliance with regulations and follow-through on government messaging.

The compensation package for this position is comprised of base salary ($188,400–$309,600), bonus, equity and/or cash incentive award, as well as health care and other group benefit plans.
阿里巴巴-7000041203.requirements:
The successful candidate will have at least 5 years of progressively more responsible professional experience. 阿里巴巴-100037480002.title: CPO线-IDC 海外HRG专家-杭州
阿里巴巴-100037480002.description:
能力建设、价值创造，以身作则、感同身受、敏捷组织、简单文化，让每个加入阿里云的同学成为更好的自己，成就生生不息的阿里云。

战略落地陪伴：
1、理解业务战略，组织业务战略通晒，确保战略层层落地，不变形。
2、了解一线员工对业务战略的反馈，通过组织沟通场促进员工对业务战略的理解。
3、目标管理，协助业务搭档通过OKR工具来确保组织战略目标层层落地，促进上下游的目标拉通，同时使得员工有清晰的目标和实现路径。
4、组织阶段性复盘，通过会议及沟通场的组织，协助业务搭档及时审视和调整业务战略的执行。

组织设计：
1、理解业务，熟知行业竞对在相同模块的业务的组织架构、人员能力和差距，根据业务组织发展的需要，配合业务一号位，梳理上下游生产关系，设计好组织架构、排兵布阵。
2、定岗定编，支持业务leader制定岗位及人才标准，进行人员的选、用、育、留、汰。
3、从业务出发，推动业务搭档做好业务取舍和聚焦，并形成相匹配的工资包策略和HC规划。日常做好工资包/HC管理。

人才供应与发展：
1、掌握所支持业务核心人员的来源和分布（不局限于内部、竞对、校招），分别运营好核心人才群体，做好链接。
2、用好人才系统，帮助业务团队做好人才的即时供应，保留业务所需的关键人才，促进人才新陈代谢。
3、人才发展，做好新人landing和融入，对管理者有识别赋能跟踪链接，推动支持团队的专业能力成长。

组织文化与温度：
1、深入理解文化价值观并身体力行，促进员工对文化价值观的理解、认同、共识与践行。
2、帮助管理者成为业务、组织、文化一号位，做到以身作则、感同身受，让团队同学成为更好的自己。
3、建立与员工的链接，成为员工与组织的桥梁，增强员工归属感和团队凝聚力。
4、妥善处理好各类员工事件和廉正合规事件，在组织中引导积极、正向的风气。

机制设计与数据驱动：
1、围绕业务端和组织端的各类场景，配合业务搭档建设和调优各类机制（包括沟通、决策、月报、汇报等机制），推动业务建立管理者和员工的常态化沟通、辅导、目标对齐等机制。
2、配合业务发展需求，建立奖惩机制，并在过程中不断审视和调优，激发团队战斗力，坚守底线。
3、通过数字化方法优化工作流程，提升效率，有高质量的数据洞察和结论输出。
4、使用数据看板等工具，发现问题并推动问题的解决，并提出对数据系统的优化建议。

•  能与业务leader就生产关系矛盾、人才评估和发展、排兵布阵等方面展开对话，提出解决思路和方法；能够抓住时机促成问题的解决
• 基于对阿里云业务的深度理解，能预判业务关键问题，通过多渠道的调研和验证问题， 能理解问题的关键争议点，多维度评估影响，找到解决问题的突破点
• 针对跨部门的复杂问题，能结合应用场景，制定某一领域的解决方案，并留有预案，和不同部门的业务leader、HR达成共识
• 能分析行业竞对在相同模块业务的组织架构与人员构成，识别人才能力差距，推动排兵布阵优化
• 能掌握所支持业务的核心人员来源和分布（内部/竞对/校招），识别潜在人才，定向链接、持续运营 
• 能支持业务leader，基于人才标准开展人才盘点，共同识别优秀人员进入人才培养池
• 熟练掌握数据分析方法，独立执行HR专业领域相关的复杂性数据分析，能发现问题并找到根因，输出改进建议
• 熟悉现有的数据看板等系统产品，能提出系统产品的优化改进建议，提升工作效率

阿里巴巴-100055340009.title: CPO线-产研 HRG专家-北京/杭州
阿里巴巴-100055340009.description:
能力建设、价值创造，以身作则、感同身受、敏捷组织、简单文化，让每个加入阿里云的同学成为更好的自己，成就生生不息的阿里云。

战略落地陪伴：
1、理解业务战略，组织业务战略通晒，确保战略层层落地，不变形。
2、了解一线员工对业务战略的反馈，通过组织沟通场促进员工对业务战略的理解。
3、目标管理，协助业务搭档通过OKR工具来确保组织战略目标层层落地，促进上下游的目标拉通，同时使得员工有清晰的目标和实现路径。
4、组织阶段性复盘，通过会议及沟通场的组织，协助业务搭档及时审视和调整业务战略的执行。

组织设计：
1、理解业务，熟知行业竞对在相同模块的业务的组织架构、人员能力和差距，根据业务组织发展的需要，配合业务一号位，梳理上下游生产关系，设计好组织架构、排兵布阵。
2、定岗定编，支持业务leader制定岗位及人才标准，进行人员的选、用、育、留、汰。
3、从业务出发，推动业务搭档做好业务取舍和聚焦，并形成相匹配的工资包策略和HC规划。日常做好工资包/HC管理。

人才供应与发展：
1、掌握所支持业务核心人员的来源和分布（不局限于内部、竞对、校招），分别运营好核心人才群体，做好链接。
2、用好人才系统，帮助业务团队做好人才的即时供应，保留业务所需的关键人才，促进人才新陈代谢。
3、人才发展，做好新人landing和融入，对管理者有识别赋能跟踪链接，推动支持团队的专业能力成长。

组织文化与温度：
1、深入理解文化价值观并身体力行，促进员工对文化价值观的理解、认同、共识与践行。
2、帮助管理者成为业务、组织、文化一号位，做到以身作则、感同身受，让团队同学成为更好的自己。
3、建立与员工的链接，成为员工与组织的桥梁，增强员工归属感和团队凝聚力。
4、妥善处理好各类员工事件和廉正合规事件，在组织中引导积极、正向的风气。

机制设计与数据驱动：
1、围绕业务端和组织端的各类场景，配合业务搭档建设和调优各类机制（包括沟通、决策、月报、汇报等机制），推动业务建立管理者和员工的常态化沟通、辅导、目标对齐等机制。
2、配合业务发展需求，建立奖惩机制，并在过程中不断审视和调优，激发团队战斗力，坚守底线。
3、通过数字化方法优化工作流程，提升效率，有高质量的数据洞察和结论输出。
4、使用数据看板等工具，发现问题并推动问题的解决，并提出对数据系统的优化建议。
阿里巴巴-100055340009.requirements:
• 能够通过与主管和员工开展有效的沟通交流，及时感知团队温度、洞察组织问题，推动及时解决
• 能与业务leader就生产关系矛盾、人才评估和发展、排兵布阵等方面展开对话，提出解决思路和方法；能够抓住时机促成问题的解决
• 基于对阿里云业务的深度理解，能预判业务关键问题，通过多渠道的调研和验证问题
• 能理解问题的关键争议点，多维度评估影响，找到解决问题的突破点
• 针对跨部门的复杂问题，能结合应用场景，制定某一领域的解决方案，并留有预案，和不同部门的业务leader、HR达成共识
• 能分析行业竞对在相同模块业务的组织架构与人员构成，识别人才能力差距，推动排兵布阵优化
• 能掌握所支持业务的核心人员来源和分布（内部/竞对/校招），识别潜在人才，定向链接、持续运营
• 能支持业务leader，基于人才标准开展人才盘点，共同识别优秀人员进入人才培养池
• 熟练掌握数据分析方法，独立执行HR专业领域相关的复杂性数据分析，能发现问题并找到根因，输出改进建议
• 熟悉现有的数据看板等系统产品，能提出系统产品的优化改进建议，提升工作效率

阿里巴巴-100002886014.title: Cainiao-HRSSC Specialist-Madrid
阿里巴巴-100002886014.description:
1. Employee Life Cycle Management
· Manage core HR processes including onboarding, transfer, termination, and contract signing/renewal for assigned countries.
· Maintain employee records, working hours, and leave data to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timeliness.
· Optimize employee data governance to improve data quality and consistency.
· Support annual audits and compliance checks in line with local labor laws and company policies.

2. Employee Benefits Administration
· Administer employee benefit programs including commercial insurance, supplemental medical plans, and annual health checks.
· Coordinate with vendors, verify invoices, and manage cost allocation to ensure accuracy and compliance.
· Review and optimize benefit policies based on employee feedback to enhance satisfaction and engagement.

3. HR Inquiry & Service Support
· Act as the first-line HR SSC contact, responding promptly to employee inquiries via DingTalk, phone, ticketing system, or onsite support.
· Provide accurate HR policy interpretation and process guidance to ensure a consistent employee experience.
· Maintain and update the FAQ knowledge base to improve efficiency and reduce response time.

4. Data & Process Optimization
· Identify and implement process and system improvement opportunities to enhance automation and digitalization.
· Maintain and update HR module SOP documentation to ensure process standardization and compliance.
· Participate in key digital HR projects, including Hi HR system and payroll submission automation.
· Deliver regular HR reports and analytics to support business decision-making.

1. 员工全生命周期管理
· 负责所辖国家员工的入职、调动、离职、合同签订与续签等核心人事流程；
· 管理员工档案、工时及假期，确保数据准确、合规、及时；
· 优化员工数据治理流程，提升数据质量与一致性；
· 支持年度审计及合规检查，确保符合当地劳动法规与公司政策。

2. 员工福利管理
· 统筹员工商业保险、补充医疗、年度体检等福利项目的日常运营；
· 对接供应商、核对账单并完成费用分摊，确保准确与合规；
· 定期回顾福利政策，收集反馈并提出优化建议，提升员工满意度。

3. HR问询与服务支持
· 作为HR SSC一线窗口，通过阿里钉、电话、工单系统或现场支持快速响应员工咨询；
· 提供准确的政策解读与流程指导，保障一致的员工体验；
· 定期维护FAQ知识库，优化流程，缩短响应时间。

4. 数据分析与流程优化
· 识别并推动HR流程与系统优化，提升自动化与数字化水平；
· 维护并更新HR模块SOP文档，确保操作标准化；
· 参与Hi HR系统及薪酬提报线上化等关键项目实施与优化；
· 输出定期人事报表与分析，支持管理决策。
阿里巴巴-100002886014.requirements:
1. Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
· Familiar with European labor regulations and HR operational processes; at least 1 year of experience in an international company or HR-related role.
· Excellent communication skills in both Chinese and English; proficiency in Spanish or another European language is required.
· Proficient in mainstream HR systems (such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, etc.) and data analysis tools like Excel.
· Detail-oriented, with strong customer service awareness, project execution skills, and a mindset for continuous improvement.

2. Preferred Qualifications
· Experience in multi-country HR operations, with the ability to balance compliance and efficiency across different jurisdictions.
· Experience in HR system implementation or automation projects, with solid understanding and hands-on practice in employee experience, data governance, and process optimization.

1. 任职要求
· 本科及以上学历，人力资源、工商管理或相关专业优先。
· 熟悉欧洲劳动法规与HR操作流程，具备1年或以上跨国企业或HR相关工作经验。
· 具备优秀的中英文沟通能力，需要至少具备西班牙语或其他欧洲国家语言能力。
· 熟悉主流HR系统（如Workday、SAP SuccessFactors等）及Excel等数据分析工具。
· 注重细节，具备较强的客户服务意识、项目推动力与持续改进精神。

2. 加分项
· 具备多国人力资源运营经验，能够平衡不同国家的合规性与效率要求。
· 有HR系统实施或自动化项目经验，对员工体验、数据治理与流程优化有相应理解与实践。

阿里巴巴-100002826086.description:
Key Responsibilities:
1. On-site Customer Service: Conduct equipment inspections, fault diagnosis, and repairs for clients in the assigned region; independently manage the full lifecycle of on-site issue resolution.
2. Complaint & After-Sales Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for end-customers in Spain and Europe regarding after-sales needs. Manage issue intake, tracking, feedback, and post-incident review. Handle customer complaints, returns/exchanges, and warranty claims.

7. Local Relationship Management: Maintain relationships with regional clients and service providers to enhance customer satisfaction and reputation for repeat business. Collaborate to achieve regional after-sales KPIs.

阿里巴巴-100025135019.description:
Analytics & Reporting
•	Build and maintain dashboards, regular reports, and automated bots that support business teams across the full range — from top-management strategic direction down to day-to-day ground operations
•	Monitor key metrics, alert the business to potential issues, and proactively spot risks and growth opportunities
•	Ensure data is accurate and consistent across all dashboards, reports, and analysis
•	Run daily, weekly, and monthly performance analysis to track business health and find opportunities

Business Partnership & Strategic Support
•	Work closely with business leaders and teams, providing analysis that supports key decisions and target achievement
•	Provide analysis and recommendations that help shape and steer business decisions on strategies, initiatives, and other key priorities
•	Track how strategies and key initiatives are performing, and surface insights on top-priority business topics
•	Contribute to cross-functional projects and business programs
•	Turn data findings into clear business language — explain what is happening, why it matters, and what to do next

AI & Innovation
•	Actively use AI tools in daily work to improve productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance output quality
•	Revamp and improve existing dashboards and reports to be AI-enabled and user-friendly
•	Build automated reporting bots and AI-assisted analytical solutions
•	Stay current with AI developments relevant to business analytics and apply them to work

On-Demand Support & Collaboration
•	Provide on-demand data support and analysis as business needs arise
•	Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their needs and deliver end-to-end analysis, from data gathering to presentation
•	Communicate with data and tech teams to turn business needs into data solutions
阿里巴巴-100025135019.requirements:
Must-have
•	Strong analytical and numerical skills — you can break down unclear problems, spot patterns, and find insights in messy data
•	Proficiency in SQL — you can write queries independently to extract, transform, and analyze data
•	Experience with dashboarding tools such as Quick BI, Tableau, or Power BI
•	Business sense — you understand (or are eager to learn) how a business works, and you think about “why” the data looks a certain way, not just “what” it shows
•	AI proficiency — you actively use AI tools in your daily work, and you genuinely enjoy using them to work smarter. Not just aware of AI, but a real user
•	Working-level English — you can read, write, and present analysis in English, as you will communicate with Singapore stakeholders regularly
•	3–5 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, strategy & planning, or a related analytical role (strong candidates with more experience are also welcome)
•	Bachelor's degree or above in a quantitative or business-related field

Good to have
•	Comfortable dealing with ambiguity, with the initiative to refine unclear goals as you go
•	Business exposure in any industry, such as offline retail, brands, or FMCG — with e-commerce, platform, or tech experience a plus
•	Ability to manage stakeholders and present analysis clearly — turning complex findings into simple business terms that non-data audiences can act on
•	Basic knowledge of Python or similar scripting for analysis and automation

阿里巴巴-100053500007.title: LAZADA-Business Intelligence Manager / Senior Manager-Retail
阿里巴巴-100053500007.description:
• 负责自营业务的经营分析，覆盖选品、定价、采购、库存周转、毛利等环节，搭建品类经营指标体系和监控看板。
• 深入分析品类和商品，找到增长机会和经营问题，产出可以落地的策略建议，并跟踪落地效果。
• 和采销、运营、供应链团队紧密协作，支持备货计划、促销复盘、商品汰换等关键决策。
阿里巴巴-100053500007.requirements:
• 本科及以上学历，985/211或海外知名院校优先，统计、数学、经济、计算机等相关专业优先。
• 5年以上数据分析或BI经验，其中至少3年自营零售或电商经验。有自营业务背景的优先。
• 熟悉自营经营逻辑，理解GMV、毛利、周转、缺货、价格力等核心指标之间的关系，能从数据里找到问题并推动业务落地。
• 分析能力和逻辑能力强，能把复杂问题拆清楚。熟练使用SQL。

阿里巴巴-100049360003.title: LAZADA-Finance Business Partner-Cross-Border Logistics
阿里巴巴-100049360003.description:
1. 业务支持与财务测算：深入理解干线、清关、尾程等跨境物流业务模式。在拓展新链路、引入核心供应商等关键业务场景中，提供严谨的投入产出测算与财务评估，为业务决策提供可靠的数据支撑。
2. 经营分析与业绩复盘：搭建并持续优化跨境物流经营分析模型，定期输出财务与业务分析报告，剖析业绩差异原因，定位业务痛点，提供财务改善建议。
3. 价卡管理与成本优化：协同业务部门制定并优化物流收入与成本价卡，挖掘降本增效空间推动落地。
4.跨部门协同与业财数字化：作为财务与业务、采购、产研等团队的协同枢纽，推动物流计费系统的迭代优化与业财流程的线上化建设。
阿里巴巴-100049360003.requirements:
1. 学历与经验：财务、会计、供应链等相关专业本科及以上；3-5年以上财务BP或FP&A经验，有物流、供应链或互联网行业背景优先。
2. 专业技能：财务基础扎实，熟悉财务建模、预算预测及差异分析；熟练使用Excel及主流BI工具，有AI工具应用经验者优先。
3. 业务洞察：熟悉物流/供应链业务模式及成本结构，能独立完成物流成本损益分析，具备良好的商业敏锐度。
4. 协同推动：具备优秀的跨部门沟通协调能力，能有效推动业财流程优化、系统升级等跨团队项目落地。
5. 综合素质：责任心强，具备自驱力与结果导向思维；英语读写流利，可满足日常工作需求。

阿里巴巴-100056620001.title: LAZADA-Finance-Senior Finance Business Partner
阿里巴巴-100056620001.description:
Lazada Regional Retail Finance Business Partner
Support sustainable business growth, project implementation, and business incubation through the development of a financial analysis framework, improvement of processes and mechanisms, and productization of finance-business collaboration.

Responsibilities:
1. Business Partnering: Deeply participate in business decisions; jointly define positioning and go-to-market approaches; propose and drive implementation plans from a finance perspective; evaluate project ROI and drive continuous cost reduction and efficiency improvement.
2. Business Analysis: Conduct data-driven full-chain analysis across supply, pricing, inventory, logistics, etc.; identify optimization opportunities from a competitor perspective and drive business breakthroughs; build a finance-business analysis framework and provide management recommendations.
3. Budget and P&L Management: Complete P&L budgeting/forecasting and set assessment mechanisms based on industry strategies and category plans; co-build P&L management strategies with business teams; execute finance-business management across gross margin, procurement, inventory, logistics fulfillment, etc.
4. Product Development: Drive the productization of finance-business data; support the mining, consolidation, and analysis of financial data across dimensions; improve operational efficiency and process governance.
阿里巴巴-100056620001.requirements:
Requirements
1. More than 8 years of experience in the FP&A and FBP scope, preferably 4+ years of experience in retail / e-commerce industry; deep understanding of retail financial metrics and industry strategies.
2. Solid financial expertise; familiar with financial management processes; strong compliance and risk-control awareness.
3. Clear logic; strong data analysis and process optimization capabilities; able to propose systematic solutions and drive cross-functional implementation.
4. Strong business acumen and learning ability; able to quickly adapt to business changes; integrity, resilience, sense of responsibility, and collaboration.
5. Excellent communication and coordination skills, fluent in English speaking and writing; able to drive business progress in a timely manner; proficient in Excel and adopting AI tools for financial modeling and presentation.

阿里巴巴-100052960002.description:
Reporting to the Regional Talent Acquisition Head, you will be responsible for:
1. End to end recruitment process of all roles within the assigned business unit/s
2. Successful delivery of talent against pre-defined SLAs and KPIs
3. Identifying ways to deliver a consistent and scalable recruitment experience to all stakeholders
4. Upholding a focus on candidate experience, diversity and building long-term relationships

3. E-commerce experience would be preferable but not essential
4. Demonstrated success in recruiting for a high-volume hiring environment for fast paced and growing company where priorities can change
5. Ability to build relationships with internal stakeholders, customers, senior leaders and peers alike

阿里巴巴-100025155031.title: LAZADA-HRBP-Hangzhou
阿里巴巴-100025155031.description:
We are looking for a seasoned HRBP to partner with Lazada's business leaders in shaping organizational capability and driving people strategies that fuel growth. This role sits at the intersection of business and people — you will be the trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, translating business priorities into actionable HR solutions.
我们正在寻找一位HRBP，与Lazada业务管理者紧密搭档，塑造组织能力并驱动支撑增长的人才战略。这个角色处于业务与人才的交汇点——你将成为高管的信赖顾问，将业务重点转化为可落地的人才解决方案。

Business Partnering / 业务搭档
Serve as the primary HR partner to one or more business units, deeply understanding their strategy, operating model, and challenges
作为一个或多个业务单元的首要HR搭档，深入理解其战略、运营模式与挑战
Translate business goals into people priorities — including workforce planning, organizational design, and talent pipeline development
将业务目标转化为人才重点——包括人力规划、组织设计和人才梯队建设

Organizational Development / 组织发展
Diagnose organizational health through data and stakeholder insights; proactively identify structural or cultural friction points and propose solutions
通过数据和利益相关方洞察诊断组织健康度；主动识别结构或文化层面的瓶颈并提出解决方案
Support change management initiatives such as reorganization, new market entry, or cross-regional operating model rollout
支持变革管理项目，如组织调整、新市场进入或跨区域运营模式落地

Talent Management / 人才管理
Partner with COE teams to design and implement performance management, succession planning, and leadership development programs tailored to local business needs
与COE团队协作，设计并落地贴合本地业务需求的绩效管理、继任计划和领导力发展项目
Drive talent review cycles, identify high-potential employees, and create targeted development plans

3、Explore and implement AI technologies in product management scenarios. Drive intelligent upgrades in product listing, category mapping, attribute filling, and other processes.
4、Optimize product listing workflows, lower the barrier for sellers to list products, and improve listing efficiency and accuracy.
5、Accountable for core metrics including product quality, listing efficiency, and front-end GMV growth. Drive product iterations through data-driven insights to support business objectives.

5、结果导向，能在快节奏环境中承受一定工作压力。具备较强的执行力和自驱力，关注业务价值产出，愿意为达成目标付出额外努力。
6、英语能力优秀（听说读写流利）者优先，需与海外团队进行日常工作沟通，熟悉东南亚电商市场者加分。

阿里巴巴-100056560001.title: LAZADA-导购运营（搜推方向）-杭州
阿里巴巴-100056560001.description:
1. 搜推及My Account域运营策略制定与落地
-- 负责搜推及 My Account 域的运营策略制定，对域内用户体验和核心业务结果负责
-- 基于数据分析与用户洞察，持续优化域内模块布局、资源分配策略和流量分发效率，驱动 GMV、UVCTR 等核心指标增长
-- 主导每月大促的域内整体方案策划，包括 HP Module 配置策略、资源位排期、素材规范制定，协调六国完成从 Teasing 到 D-Day 的全链路落地

2. 产品迭代驱动与 SOP 建设
-- 深入理解导购产品逻辑，基于运营痛点和 Local 反馈，主动定义产品优化需求，推动 Homepage、My Account等产品模块的功能迭代
-- 梳理并沉淀域内运营 SOP，建立资源位管理、素材审核、配置复查等标准化流程，提升团队整体运营效率和可复制性

3. AI 场景探索与效率提升
-- 负责AI 自动化配置平台的运营推广，推动 Campaign 配置流程从人工向自动化转型，持续提升配置覆盖率与准确率
-- 探索 AI 在导购场景的进一步应用，包括智能资源分配、素材自动生成、运营效率诊断等方向，推动 AI 能力在域内的实际落地，与产品技术团队紧密协作，将业务需求转化为 AI 产品方案，完成从需求定义、方案验证到规模化推广的闭环

阿里巴巴-100025155011.title: LAZADA-平台治理运营专家-杭州
阿里巴巴-100025155011.description:
ꔷ 设计可扩展的治理政策与衡量体系：基于区域法规与业务场景，构建覆盖正品保障、准时达承诺、商品质量管理、商家行为准则等核心领域的治理政策框架，并配套科学的指标体系，支撑策略迭代与效果评估。
Develop a cohesive governance policy framework—spanning authenticity guarantees, on-time delivery commitments, product quality standards, and seller conduct guidelines which grounded in regional regulatory requirements and business contexts. Establish scientific measurement framework to evaluate policy effectiveness.
ꔷ 推动区域-本地政策对齐与高效落地：主导与各国本地团队的常态化对齐机制，制定差异化实施细则，在确保合规的前提下，实现治理规则在本地市场的高效、一致执行。
Drive Regional-to-Local Policy Alignment and Effective Execution—Lead a structured, ongoing collaboration mechanism with local teams across markets to develop market-specific implementation guidelines. Ensure governance policies are executed efficiently, consistently while fully complying with local regulations.
ꔷ 端到端管理核心治理运营流程：全面负责风险审核、违规处置、商家申诉、赔偿发放等关键环节，持续优化流程效率，保障高准确率、高时效性及卓越的用户体验。
End-to-End Ownership of Core Governance Operations—Take full accountability for critical workflows,including risk-based listing reviews, violation enforcement, seller appeals, and compensation disbursement...continuously optimizing operational efficiency to ensure high accuracy, rapid turnaround and an exceptional user experience.
ꔷ 建立反馈闭环机制，驱动策略与产品迭代：密切关注本地买家/卖家反馈及监管动态，快速识别高优风险事件，制定应对方案。持续将一线洞察反哺产品与策略团队，推动政策与平台能力持续迭代。
Establish a Closed-Loop Feedback Mechanism to Drive Policy and Product Iteration—Closely monitor buyer/seller feedback and regulatory developments in local markets. Rapidly identify high-priority risk events, formulate effective response plans.  Systematically channel frontline insights to product and policy teams to drive agile,continuous iteration of governance rules and platform capabilities.
ꔷ 领导跨国治理运营团队：直接管理分布于多个国家的治理运营团队，清晰设定目标、系统赋能成长、优化协同机制，打造一支高绩效、高凝聚力、可持续发展的全球化团队。
Directly lead a globally distributed governance operations team—clearly define goals, systematically empower growth, and strengthen collaboration mechanisms—to build a high performing, cohesive,and sustainable global team.
阿里巴巴-100025155011.requirements:
ꔷ 6年以上电商平台运营经验，具备国际电商平台（尤其是东南亚市场）的治理、合规或信任与安全相关背景者优先；
6+ years of e-commerce operations experience, Experience in governance or Trust & Safety at SEA-focused platforms is a strong plus.
ꔷ 出色的解决方案设计能力：能从复杂业务场景中识别根因，设计系统性、可落地的治理方案，并通过强项目管理能力确保执行闭环。
Strong solution design skills—Able to diagnose core issues in complexity, design systemic governance solutions, and execute them effectively.
ꔷ 卓越的跨文化沟通与影响力：善于在多元文化、无直接汇报关系的环境中快速建立信任、化解分歧，并高效推动跨团队共识与落地；
Exceptional cross-cultural communication and influence—Able to quickly build trust and bridge differences in multicultural environments,driving cross-team alignment and ensuring effective execution even without direct authority.
ꔷ 成熟的跨国团队管理能力：有带领多国成员的实际经验，擅长目标设定、人才赋能与团队文化建设，持续打造高绩效、高凝聚力的全球化团队；
Proven global team leadership—Has hands-on experience leading multicultural teams, and excels at building high-performing, cohesive global teams through clear goal-setting, talent empowerment and team culture development.
ꔷ 英语为工作语言，需具备流利的听说读写能力：能自如主持跨国会议、撰写政策文档、向全球高管清晰汇报；
Must operate fluently in English across all communication modes—with zero language barrier in cross-border collaboration, documentation, or executive engagement.
ꔷ 熟悉 AI 与数据驱动的治理技术：掌握机器学习基础知识，可结合数据分析与 AI 驱动设计高效的政策执行流程及风险防控原则；有相关项目实践经验者优先。
Familiarity with AI-driven governance technologies—understanding basic machine learning principles and leveraging AI tools for designing efficient policy execution workflows and risk management mechanisms. Relevant hands-on experience is a plus.

阿里巴巴-100054840002.title: M&T事业部-效果广告运营-杭州
阿里巴巴-100054840002.description:
围绕猫超效果广告的核心产品能力，面向猫超商家设计并落地「增投」策略：从商家分层洞察出发定制差异化增投方案，拆解为可执行运营动作并推动落地，最终对增投商家数、增投金额与广告 ROI/GMV 增量负责
1、增投策略设计——基于效果广告核心产品能力（关键词推广、货品推广、全站/智能推广、人群定向、智能出价、内容场域投放），针对不同层级、品类、经营阶段的猫超商家定制差异化增投方案，明确增投目标、预算结构、产品组合与预期 ROI。
2、方案落地执行——把策略拆成可执行动作：商家分层触达、投放诊断、账户与计划搭建、出价与预算调优、大促节点排期；联合行业小二、商家运营、代理商共同推进，对执行节奏与完成质量负责。
3、运营结果负责——以增投商家数、增投金额、广告消耗、ROI/ROAS、GMV 增量为核心指标，建立「目标—过程—结果」追踪机制；用对照组与 A/B 验证策略有效性，持续迭代并沉淀可复制方法论与 SOP。
4、数据洞察与产品反哺——分析商家投放数据与行业大盘，识别增投机会点与卡点（预算瓶颈、货品结构、人群覆盖、素材效率、归因口径），输出洞察报告并把一线问题结构化反馈产品技术，推动能力迭代与工具化。
5、商家赋能与规模化——设计交付商家培训、标杆案例包装与最佳实践输出，提升商家自主投放能力，把单点打法放大为规模化增投。

阿里巴巴-100040220004.description:
1、负责淘工厂产业带及重点品类的经营策略制定与落地，围绕品类供给、价格带、商品结构和供给质量优化，提升核心品类竞争力与平台 GMV；
2、建设商品运营与管理机制，完善商品准入、分层、标签、质量、价格及经营诊断体系，结合数据洞察识别品类和商品经营问题，并推动策略闭环；
3、负责商家及商品全生命周期运营，推动商家引入、入驻冷启、分层成长，以及商品选品、上新、测款、动销、爆品孵化和商品淘汰等关键链路的效率提升；
4、基于产业带商家需求与供给链路，探索 AI 在商家经营、智能选品、商品运营、营销托管、客服及履约等场景的应用，推动商家全链路智能化经营；
5、协同商品运营、产品、技术、算法、体验等团队推进项目落地，围绕商家增长、商品供给、动销效率和 GMV 制定可量化指标，并持续复盘优化。

1、3 年及以上电商商家运营、商品运营、品类运营或平台产品运营经验；有独立负责品类策略、商品供给或商家增长核心模块的经验者优先；
2、熟悉电商商品经营全链路，具备选品、上新、商品分层、价格带管理、商品质量治理、动销提升、爆品孵化等上述一个或多个方向具备实战经验；
3、熟悉白牌商家、源头工厂或产业带生态，了解供应链资源与行业趋势，具备较强的产业带电商全链路业务理解能力；
4、对 AI 技术及其商业化应用有一定认知或相关实践经验，能够结合业务场景推动智能选品、经营诊断、营销运营等能力落地；
5、具备较强的数据敏感度和结构化分析能力，能够基于商家、商品、品类等经营数据发现问题、制定策略并验证效果；能熟练使用 SQL、Excel 等分析工具者优先；
6、具备强目标导向和项目推进能力，能够与业务、产品、算法、技术等团队协作并对结果负责。

阿里巴巴-100052740005.title: M&T事业部-淘工厂-营销产品经理
阿里巴巴-100052740005.description:
1、营销工具与大促活动产品：负责直降、满减等日常营销工具与大促营销活动的接入及产品设计；持续简化商家报名与参与链路，提升商品控价活动的渗透率，助力商品成长与打爆，并将营销投入转化为可衡量、可追溯的业务增量。
2、基于 LTV 的用户投资策略：协同算法团队，从长周期 LTV 视角设计人群分层、券门槛与面额的组合策略；以增量 LTV（拉新转化、复访复购、购买频次提升等）而非单次投放 ROI 衡量效果，持续优化补贴效率与预算分配，挖掘新的增长点。
3、需求洞察与产品策略规划：通过竞对分析、商家调研与数据洞察，定位需求痛点与增长机会；制定营销产品的中长期策略与迭代路线，构建可系统性提升商品转化效率的营销体系。
4、跨域协同与项目落地：与用户产品、行业运营、商家产品、技术、财务、风控等团队紧密协同，推动跨团队决策与问题闭环，保障大促等高压节点下重点项目按时、高质量交付。
阿里巴巴-100052740005.requirements:
1、本科及以上学历，2 年以上互联网产品经验；有营销工具、优惠券、大促营销活动、价格力（比价/控价）相关产品经验者优先。
2、擅长结合 AI 解决实际问题，过往工作中有 AI 应用落地案例者优先。
3、逻辑思维与结构化表达能力强，能将复杂业务规则抽象为体系化的产品模型与可配置能力。
4、数据分析能力强，对数字敏感，能自主取数、验证假设，从数据中发现问题并驱动策略调整。
5、责任心与自驱力强，抗压能力好，注重细节，能同时兼顾商家侧参与成本与用户侧优惠感知体验。

4、以零售单品经营逻辑运营爆品，统筹商品全生命周期（引入、成长、成熟、清仓），通过与商家协同定价、库存与周转管理提升单品效能及 ROI，结合动销率与售罄率动态优化货盘，实现"上得准、卖得动、清得掉"。
5、洞察性价比／质价比人群与消费趋势，把握消费者购买决策的关键因素，在销售策略、定价、渠道推广与玩法互动上产出方案并落地执行，以"商品 × 价格 × 供应链"的零售效率组合取胜，而非单纯的平台化流量运营。

阿里巴巴-100028320001.title: M&T事业部-淘工厂-食品生鲜行业运营
阿里巴巴-100028320001.description:
1.品类战略规划与执行：负责零食行业类目运营，制定行业整体运营策略，负责品类规模增长及商家商品的孵化运营，达成业务增长目标。
2.商家与商品供给管理：基于市场趋势及消费需求和平台&类目需求，制定商家商品引入计划和跟进，确保品类供给多样性与商品竞争力，提升类目规模增长。
3.客户增长方案设计：针对不同客户类型（如地域品牌商家、产业带中小商家等），通过整合平台渠道资源，熟悉淘系商品运营规则，来定制设计业务增长方案，引导客户在平台实现健康可持续增长，完成其销售规模跃迁。
4.营销活动策划与执行：能洞察零食行业市场动态及消费趋势，策划符合品类特性的营销活动（如节日促销、节令促销、场景化营销），提升品类在业务中的影响力。
5.运营创新与机制优化：对零食供应链有一定了解，能快速引入符合新业务的货盘模式供给，帮助推动优化平台场域机制与售卖策略，推动品类运营模式升级。
阿里巴巴-100028320001.requirements:
1.行业经验：3年以上零食行业经验，具备互联网货架电商类目运营经验；有淘系、淘工厂平台运营或品牌运营经验者优先。
2.市场拓展能力：熟悉零食行业发展趋势，具备一定产业带商家资源，具有资源整合能力及市场开拓经验，能有效推动商家与平台品类策略结合落地。
3.核心能力：市场洞察：敏锐捕捉消费趋势及品类机会；数据分析：熟练运用数据驱动决策，优化运营动作；全局观：兼顾短期目标与长期品类价值，制定系统性运营策略。
4.综合素质与软技能：优秀的沟通协调能力，能完成与不同类型商家沟通和谈判，并完成日常BD任务工作拿结果能力，具备过程管理方法论；善于在内部跨团队协作，完成日常工作推进需求；目标认同感&导向强；具备快速学习能力和抗压能力强，能在快节奏中有效推进工作和调整自我能力。
5.AI工具使用：有一定AI知识基础，并能熟练使用AI工具在工作中提效；有在任职的业务中使用AI工具并取得结果者优先。

阿里巴巴-100052220001.title: M&T事业部-物流运营（仓履约管理）-杭州
阿里巴巴-100052220001.description:
1. 日常运营管理：基于前台业务对仓储物流的履约标准和考核要求，协同和跟进仓储服务商的日常运营管理，推进履约质量达成目标，及时响应并推进异常问题的解决；
2. 大促运营保障：协同前端供应链，与仓储服务商在大促单量预测、产能协同、过程跟进以及事后复盘等事项上拉通信息并跟进达成，保障大促仓配履约的稳定性；
3. 指标监控与异常闭环：建立并维护服务水平协议（SLA）、时效、质量、成本、库存准确率、产能、生产效率与安全等指标看板，开展日/周/月运营分析；对重大异常进行根因分析、纠偏与复盘。
4. 跨部门协同及流程优化：识别仓内及上下游流程瓶颈，推动标准作业程序（SOP）、作业策略、管理机制和现场改善，形成可衡量、可复制的解决方案，并进行推广；
5. 系统、数据与AI能力建设：提出并管理与WMS、数据能力、AI工作台等物流相关的产品需求，参与方案评审、验收测试及上线运营，提升物流产品的能力和效率。
6. 自动化与智能化项目。结合仓储业务场景和实际需求，发起和推动仓内自动化与智能化相关项目，推动仓内作业效率的提升和综合运营成本的节降。
阿里巴巴-100052220001.requirements:
1.  本科及以上学历，物流管理、供应链管理等相关专业优先；能力突出者可适当放宽。
2.  5年以上仓储、物流或供应链运营经验，有区域、仓群、跨仓业务链路或跨组织重大专项独立负责经验者优先。
3.  熟悉仓储运营全流程及关键指标，理解入库（IB）、出库（OB）、库存、产能、履约、质量、成本与安全之间的联动关系。
4.  具有复杂问题分析与改善能力，能够使用数据定位问题、评估方案、跟踪收益并完成闭环。
5.  具有跨部门项目管理经验，能推动业务、产品技术、现场团队和外部服务商共同交付。
6.  具备良好的沟通表达、结构化汇报和风险意识，能够适应必要的仓内现场工作与出差。

6. 自动化与智能化项目。结合仓储业务场景和实际需求，发起和推动仓内自动化与智能化相关项目，推动仓内作业效率的提升和综合运营成本的节降。

1.  本科及以上学历，物流管理、供应链管理等相关专业优先；能力突出者可适当放宽。
2.  5年以上仓储、物流或供应链运营经验，有区域、仓群、跨仓业务链路或跨组织重大专项独立负责经验者优先。
3.  熟悉仓储运营全流程及关键指标，理解入库（IB）、出库（OB）、库存、产能、履约、质量、成本与安全之间的联动关系。
4.  具有复杂问题分析与改善能力，能够使用数据定位问题、评估方案、跟踪收益并完成闭环。
5.  具有跨部门项目管理经验，能推动业务、产品技术、现场团队和外部服务商共同交付。
6.  具备良好的沟通表达、结构化汇报和风险意识，能够适应必要的仓内现场工作与出差。

阿里巴巴-100056020004.title: M&T事业部-食品生鲜鲜花-粮油生鲜行业运营
阿里巴巴-100056020004.description:
1.品类战略规划与执行：负责粮油速食及生鲜行业（水产、肉禽蛋、水果蔬菜、温层食品）特定类目运营，制定行业整体运营策略，推动品类发展及商家商品运营，达成业务增长目标。
2.商家与商品供给管理：基于市场趋势及消费需求，制定商家商品引入计划，通过招商机制优化及资源整合，确保品类供给多样性与商品竞争力。
3.客户增长方案设计：针对不同客户类型（如KA商家、中小品牌等），整合平台与渠道资源，定制化设计业务增长方案，引导客户在平台实现健康可持续增长。
4.营销活动策划与执行：洞察粮油速食及生鲜行业市场动态及消费趋势，策划符合品类特性的营销活动（如节日促销、节令促销、场景化营销），提升品类影响力。
5.运营创新与机制优化：深入研究行业特征，引入新业态及创新供给模式，优化平台场域机制与售卖策略，推动品类运营模式升级。
阿里巴巴-100056020004.requirements:
1.行业经验：3年以上粮油速食及生鲜行业经验，具备互联网电商或传统零售背景优先；有社区团购、品牌电商运营经验者优先。
2.市场拓展能力：熟悉粮油生鲜行业发展趋势，具备资源整合能力及市场开拓经验，能高效推动商家合作与品类策略落地。
3.核心能力：市场洞察：敏锐捕捉消费趋势及品类机会；数据分析：熟练运用数据驱动决策，优化运营动作；全局观：兼顾短期目标与长期品类价值，制定系统性运营策略。
4.综合素质与软技能：优秀的沟通协调能力，目标导向，具备过程管理方法论；抗压能力强，能在复杂环境中高效推进工作。

阿里巴巴-100053500002.description:

1. 行业运营：通过对市场趋势和用户洞察形成有效策略，基于目标拆解落地品类规划，对类目的买家体量和生意结果负责

2. 熟悉行业供给资源，了解行业或平台品类规划/品牌/产业带/商业化等关键环节，有较强的商家赋能和牵引能力
3. 熟悉零售和行业运营方法论，对消费者和场景运营有经验者优先考虑

5. 跨团队协同能力强，乐观皮实，拥抱变化，有要性和创业精神，充满激情，富有正能量
